description: 4 exemplars + 3 near-misses + 2 counterexamples. Authored 2026-08-30 under road-to-governed-harness-evolution 2.4, wave 1 (3 inbound confusion edges, no corpus). Exemplars cover the BEFORE-implementation pass on a named sensitive surface — auth, uploads, webhooks, tenancy. Near-misses are three neighbours that all look at code which already exists. CORRECTED 2026-08-30 after a completion review: this line claimed they were "the three neighbours that named it", and they are not the inbound set. At the base commit the skills naming this one were agent-security-review, ai-code-blindspots and security-maturity-assessment; the near-misses here are security-audit, security-maturity-assessment and one more, so the overlap is partial. They are chosen for semantic adjacency, which is what a near-miss is for; the inbound-edge count is what put this skill in wave 1, and the two are separate facts that the original sentence merged.

queries.q: threat-model this new file-upload endpoint before we build it
we're adding webhooks from a third party — what are the trust boundaries and abuse cases?
before I implement tenant switching, map the abuse cases onto the files that would carry them
bevor wir den neuen Login bauen — erstell bitte ein Threat Model mit Missbrauchsfällen
audit this module for SQL injection and XSS vulnerabilities
queries.note: hunting defects in code that already exists, not enumerating abuse cases for a change → security-audit

queries.q: give me a posture score for this service across the security categories
queries.note: a rating of the current state rather than an abuse-case enumeration for a planned change → security-maturity-assessment

queries.q: review this diff for authorization holes — can user A reach user B's data?
queries.note: the per-entrypoint authorization chain over a concrete diff → authz-review

queries.q: write the incident comms for the outage we're in right now
queries.note: an open production incident; shares the word 'boundaries' with nothing and must not pull a modelling skill into a live outage

queries.q: rename this class everywhere and update all the callers
queries.note: a mechanical refactor with no trust boundary in it
